body: The charge came off my card twice and I would like one of them sent back.
Box turned up with the corner crushed and everything inside rattling around.
Still nothing at my door, three weeks after the confirmation email came through.
I have raised this with my bank, because I never authorised the payment in the first place.
Wrong size arrived - I ordered the large and a small turned up instead.
Please take my details off your systems entirely, I do not want to be on file anywhere.
I shut the account down last year and you are still taking money out every month.
The courier left the parcel with a neighbour I have never spoken to in my life.
Do you do this one in a wider fitting, or is it only the standard width?
Your checkout will not take my new card - it just spins and then throws me back to the basket.
The reset link you send me has already expired by the time it lands in my inbox.
I would rather have the money back than a credit note to spend with you again.
Nobody has come back to me on either of the last two emails I sent about this.
The zip gave out after a fortnight of fairly light use, which I did not expect.
